# QYL0104: Invalid ActivitySource name

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

## Description

ActivitySource names should follow the reverse-DNS naming convention (e.g., 'company.product.component'). Names must contain at least one dot, use only lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens, and should not contain spaces. This ensures consistent identification across telemetry backends.
